title: Level 5 (World Class) - A-7
notes:
West leads the ♠3 against 6♣. It looks like a Morton's Fork coup. South will eventually lead the ♥4 placing West on the horns of a dilemma.

If West plays low, the ♥K will win. South can discard the ♥Q on dummy's spade winner and concede just a diamond trick (diamonds must be 3-2 for the contract to have a chance). If West takes the ♥A, South will have a discard in hearts as well as spades. South will not lose a diamond trick.

There is only one possible problem. If North plays dummy's ♠Q or ♠K at trick 1, East might duck. South would be forced to discard too early, destroying the Morton's Fork.

The contract can be made if South plays low from dummy at trick 1 and ruffs in the closed hand. South draws 1 round of trumps, making sure to play the ♣5 from dummy, and plays the ♥4. West has to make his decision before South. If West ducks, South wins the ♥K and sets up a spade trick for a heart discard. South will lose only a diamond trick.

If West takes the ♥A, North has a discard available in hearts for 1 of South's diamonds. North has sufficient trump entries left to set up and also enjoy a spade winner for another diamond discard.
